newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

In answer to a question spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commission President Jacques Santer and UK Prime Minister Tony Blair had exchanged letters about recent controversy over the circumvention of fishing quotas. Answering Tony Blair, Santer said that certain conditions which establish an economic link between fishing vessels and the Member State whose flag it is flying were authorised under current Community legislation if there were non-discriminatory, alternative and proportional.

Spokeswoman Sarah Lambert said Italy's planned cash injection into flag carrier Alitalia would be considered as state aid. She added that the EU executive would decide on any aid-approval conditions before the end of July.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/562: Right of residence: European Commission decides to refer Greece and Italy to the Court of Justice.
- IP/97/564 REV: Digital television: Commission opens infringement proceedings against Spain.
- IP/97/573: Municipal voting: European Commission decides to refer Belgium to Court of Justice.
- IP/97/574: Commission authorises VIAG's acquisition of TH. Goldsmidt AG.
- IP/97/575: Commission authorises the acquisition by Ferrostaal AG of sole control of DSD Dillinger Stahlbau GmbH.
- Memo/97/66: Calendar of EU Institutions activities for June 30 to July 6, 1997.
- European Commission DGX: Results of "continuous tracking" surveys of European opinion (February to May 1997).
- Eurostat news release No 46/97: EU GDP up 1.6% in 1996.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Economy and finance No 1997-21: Net lending or net borrowing of the sectors of the EU national economies: 1980-1995.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Economy and finance No 1997-22: Gross domestic product and its components - first values for 1996.
- Eurostat - Asylum seekers No 1-1997: Asylum-seekers in Europe in the first nine months of 1996.
- Eurostat - Quaterly national accounts - ESA No 2-1997.
